opening.argument: The offer presents mining as passive income, advertising a 3% daily return while directing viewers to a miner page with a BNB amount field and a button to hire miners. The presenter further says that hired miners will place the tokens they find into the viewer’s barrel, and promotes a 10% reward from deposits made through circulated referral links. The FAQ presents unlimited tokens at a 3% starting daily rate. Separate giveaway and alerts-group offers involve social engagement and payment, but the available material does not establish whether the returns, giveaway funds, or alerts were delivered.
